title: Live Mutation Operator Evidence Map v1
description: Evidence map linking live mutation artifacts to their schemas, hashes, validation status, and operational purpose.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for this artifact in the evidence map.

path.description: Filesystem path relative to repo root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of file contents. Empty string if missing.

exists.description: Whether the artifact file exists on disk.

validates.description: Whether the artifact validates against its declared or inferred schema.

purpose.description: What this artifact provides to the operator.

consumed_by.description: Which subsystem or role consumes this artifact.

proves.description: What operational property this artifact proves.

missing_or_degraded_behavior.description: What happens if this artifact is missing or invalid.
